name: Wallpaper with Leaves
instruction: Create a wallpaper pattern featuring leaves. The leaves should be arranged in a random yet balanced manner, with varying sizes and orientations. Ensure the pattern is seamless so it can cover a large surface without any noticeable breaks.

Color representation: The color of the leaves can be green or yellow.
Size: The size set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Proportion: The leaves are proportionate to the wallpaper.
Texture and surface detail: The texture and surface detail set in the script is reasonable for the object.

Three-dimensional spatial awareness: The leaves are distributed evenly across the surface.
The varying sizes create visual interest without overcrowding.
The orientations of the leaves add dynamic movement to the pattern.
Object distance and contact: The edges of the pattern align seamlessly.
There are no visible gaps or breaks in the pattern.

Instruction execution accuracy: All specified attributes of the pattern are accurately represented.
The balance in the arrangement of leaves meets the instruction.
